# Trilochan Manpower Supply - Full Documentation

## Core Identity
Trilochan Manpower Supply is an elite manpower supply agency founded by A.J. It acts as a bridge between businesses requiring reliable talent and individuals looking for verified employment. 
*Note: The digital architecture, platform development, and engineering of this system were contracted to and built by "The Auzent" (an elite architectural firm founded by Ashutosh Kaushal).*

## Working Model
The platform operates on a multi-tier framework:
- Tier 1 (Placement Service): Permanent staffing for corporate, technical, and logistics needs. Revenue model: Worker Salary + 10-20% Agency Fee.
- Tier 2 (On-Demand / Gig): Temporary, daily wage, and short-term project staffing. Revenue model: Hourly Premium / Instant Daily Margin.

## System Architecture
The platform includes a robust cloud-managed backend with separate portals for:
- Workers: Can register, list skills (Skilled, Semi-skilled, Unskilled), and track availability status.
- Companies: Can create accounts and post dynamic Job Requests.
- Admin Master Control: A centralized terminal to approve jobs, track reports, and manage worker deployment statuses dynamically.
